seoDescription: Riikka Vuorijärvi — vocal coach and music pedagogue in Oulu, Finland. Embodied voice work, singing lessons and vocal care under Lilith co-operative.

intro.heading: Singing is your birthright!
intro.text: I am a voice teacher and music pedagogue based in Oulu, Finland, with over a decade of experience. I teach at Karjasilta, Oulu, under the cooperative Lilith. Student spots open up from time to time. Amateurs and professionals of all levels are welcome, regardless of musical genre. There is no age limit to finding your voice!
intro.note: Note: Singing lessons can also help with performance anxiety and support people who use their voice professionally.
intro.quoteText: Best vocal warmup is genuine feeling!

cards.quote: I have found the joy of singing — and even performing. I call my lessons with Riikka 'singing therapy sessions.' After the lessons, I am without exception very energetic and empowered. Thank you, Riikka.
cards.author: Jarmo, 57

cards.quote: I went to a singing lesson. What an experience! Riikka Vuorijärvi got me to really breathe properly, and when I opened my mouth – things started happening. I recommend Riikka‘s lessons from the bottom of my heart. Go, people, go!
cards.author: Woman 36
